implementation_commits.message: fix(P10-R16Q): complete probe and store invariant repair

behavioral_summary: Manager Start and Close retain the checkpoint lifecycle mutex across registration/cancellation/join, and a deterministic concurrent shutdown regression plus focused race run verify that a new sweeper cannot register while Close is joining.

Forward runtime mirrors durably envelope the exact forwards.revision generation without changing the frozen API snapshot JSON. Arm and PublishProbeJoin reject missing, legacy-unbound, stale-activation, and same-activation stale-generation mirrors; stale writes remain SQL-CAS fenced.

Processed control-inbox rows are reclaimed in bounded high-water batches across result/receipt classes while live outbox, pending deletion, live probe, terminal-delivery, and signed RCT1 digest dependencies remain protected.

Migration validation compares every required R13 index table, ordered columns, and partial predicate. A wrong same-named index now fails both transactional v5-to-v6 migration and recorded-v6 validation without weakening rollback/backfill budgets.
No frozen contract, public API document, migration SQL, or schema version was changed.
